scope: All eleven fixed citation claims, all eight ordinary body-flow citation keys, both canonical publication source files, bibliography coverage, exact source passages, metadata, cited numerical values, software-use evidence, and the bounded closest-prior-work comparison were checked. The literature conclusion is limited to the cited sources and bounded search, not worldwide priority.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage citation-check-skill extraction then independent primary-source verification, using per-key academic search templates, official DOI/arXiv/SSRN or institutional records, a checksum-bound local primary PDF, frozen local computation records for software-version and replay claims, and bib-reference-audit mechanical consistency checks.
